text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.title: Smart Auto Attack
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.a: DEFAULT: attack whenever the vanilla attack cooldown is at 100%. FIXED_INTERVAL: attack once every X ticks/seconds, ignoring the vanilla cooldown. RANDOM_INTERVAL: attack once every random X-Y ticks/seconds.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.i: Whether the fixed/random interval values below are in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second, default) or seconds.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: Used when Attack cadence = FIXED_INTERVAL. Value is in the unit chosen above.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.r: Used when Attack cadence = RANDOM_INTERVAL. Value is in the unit chosen above.
Used when Attack cadence = RANDOM_INTERVAL. Value is in the unit chosen above.

On (default): only attack when a valid entity is under your crosshair (respects the blacklist/whitelist below). Off: attack blindly on every interval whether or not anything is there - this bypasses the blacklist/whitelist entirely.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.a: Only matters for FIXED_INTERVAL/RANDOM_INTERVAL cadence (DEFAULT always waits for full charge regardless). On (default): also wait for the vanilla attack cooldown to reach 100% before swinging, even if your configured interval elapsed first - prevents weak/discharged hits from an interval shorter than your weapon's real cooldown. Off: attacks strictly on your configured interval regardless of charge, which can produce reduced-damage hits if the interval is shorter than the weapon's cooldown.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.n: Only attack while it is night (time 13000-23000). Useful for AFK-farming creakings.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.s: Off (default): Night only still applies everywhere, using the shared world-time clock even though the Nether/End have no visible day-night cycle. On: while Night only is enabled, always allow attacking in the Nether and the End (only the Overworld - or any other dimension with a real day-night cycle - still requires night).
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: Only matters when Night only is enabled. Off (default): the max duration timer counts real time elapsed since you enabled auto-attack, day or night. On: the timer pauses during the day, so only the time actually spent attacking at night counts toward the max duration limit.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.m: Auto-disable after this many hits. 0 disables the limit. Stacks with the max duration below - whichever limit is hit first stops it.
Free text, e.g. '90m', '1.5h', '5400s', '1h30m', or a bare number of seconds. Auto-disable after this long. Stacks with max hits above - whichever limit is hit first stops it.
Stop before the main-hand item's remaining durability drops below this absolute value.
Stop before the main-hand item's remaining durability drops below this percentage.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.u: Off (default): stop as soon as the current weapon's durability guard triggers. On: instead, look for another matching weapon (see Tool keyword below) elsewhere in your hotbar and switch to it, only stopping once none are left with enough durability.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.t: Used when Use more tools is on - how a hotbar item is judged as a valid replacement. KEYWORD: substring match against the item ID (see Tool keyword below). SAME_TYPE: any weapon of the same class as the one that just ran low (e.g. any sword replaces any sword), regardless of material. EXACT_MATCH: only the exact same item (e.g. only another diamond sword replaces a diamond sword).
Only used when Tool rotation mode is KEYWORD. Substring match (case-insensitive) against the weapon's item ID, e.g. 'sword' matches minecraft:diamond_sword, minecraft:netherite_sword, etc.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.h: On (default): auto-disable if your hunger drops below the threshold below, independent of the auto-eat feature. A safety net for hardcore/no-food-on-hand situations. Turn off if you don't want any hunger-based behavior at all (e.g. servers where you regenerate via a beacon and don't care about hunger).
Stop when hunger drops below this value, on the vanilla 0-20 hunger scale (20 = full, each drumstick icon = 2 points). Only used while Hunger safety stop above is on.

On (default): auto-disable if your health drops below the threshold below, on the vanilla 0-20 health scale (20 = full, each heart icon = 2 points). A safety net independent of everything else. Turn off if you don't want any health-based behavior at all.
Stop when health drops below this value, on the vanilla 0-20 health scale (20 = full, each heart icon = 2 points). Only used while Health safety stop above is on.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: BLACKLIST: attack anything except entities in the list below. WHITELIST: only attack entities in the list below.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.t: Entity type IDs, e.g. minecraft:player, minecraft:villager, minecraft:drowned, minecraft:zombified_piglin. Use the + button to add entries.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: How to notify you when auto-attack toggles or auto-stops.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.p: On (default): play the sound below whenever the mod stops itself (durability/no usable weapon left, hunger safety, hit limit, time limit). Does not play when you manually toggle it off yourself.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.a: Full sound event ID to play on auto-stop, e.g. minecraft:block.bell.use, minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup, minecraft:entity.villager.no. Invalid/unknown IDs simply play nothing.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.r: Off (default): if you reconnect yourself (not via the separate Smart Auto Reconnect mod), the mod turns itself off rather than silently resuming. On: it stays on and resumes after a short settle buffer, same as a scripted reconnect always does regardless of this setting.
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.a: On (default): auto-eat is active whenever the hotbar slot below is set. Off: auto-eat never triggers, regardless of the hotbar slot - a quick way to disable eating without losing your configured slot/threshold.
Hotbar slot (1-9) holding your food item. 0 disables auto-eat.
Eat a bite when your hunger drops below this value, on the vanilla 0-20 hunger scale (same as the hunger bar: 20 = full, each drumstick icon = 2 points, so 10 = half the bar).
text.autoconfig.smartautoattack.option.f: LIGHT (default): blocks only enchanted golden apple and pufferfish. FOOD_INSPECTOR: also blocks rotten flesh, spider eye, raw chicken, and poisonous potato. RAT: no extra blocks. Cake and chorus fruit are always blocked no matter the preset.
